readings: Using fees joined to their orders (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`) and those orders' users (`orders.userlink` = `users.userstamp`), drop any fee without a match. Compute the average fee rate (`feerate`, ignoring missing values) for each pair of orderslink and account scope (`users.acctscope`). Keep only the pairs whose average is strictly above the mean of all the pair averages, and work out how far each one exceeds that mean. Within each account scope, rank the pairs by that excess from largest to smallest and give me the top 3 pairs in each scope. Show orderslink, account scope, average fee rate, excess, and the pair's rank within its scope, all unrounded. Use competition ranks and include every pair whose rank is at most 3.

queries:
WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        p.orderslink,
        p.acctscope,
        p.average_fee_rate,
        p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.acctscope
            ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC
        ) AS pair_rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
    WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink,
           u.acctscope,
           AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT orderslink,
           acctscope,
           average_fee_rate,
           average_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages) AS excess,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY acctscope
               ORDER BY average_fee_rate DESC
           ) AS pair_rank
    FROM pair_averages
    WHERE average_fee_rate > (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages)
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        u.acctscope,
        AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        p.orderslink,
        p.acctscope,
        p.average_fee_rate,
        p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.acctscope
            ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC, p.orderslink
        ) AS pair_rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
    WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, pair_rank;
